tables.name: action_executions
tables.label: Action executions
tables.description: The durable run of an operation that talks to the outside world (an enqueued operation), created when a direct call or an approved action request authorises it. The vault runs it with retries and reconciliation; the row holds its status, final arguments and outcome. Read through action_executions.list and .get, which show you the executions whose operation you may read.

columns.name: id
columns.label: Id
columns.description: Unique id (UUIDv7).

columns.name: created_at
columns.label: Created at
columns.description: When the row was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.label: Updated at
columns.description: When the row last changed.

columns.name: organization_id
columns.label: Organization id
columns.description: The organisation that owns the row; always the deployment's single organisation.

columns.name: created_by
columns.label: Created by
columns.description: The principal that asked: the proposer for an approved request, the caller for a direct call.

columns.name: authorised_by
columns.label: Authorised by
columns.description: The principal whose authority it runs under: the approver, or the caller for a direct call.

columns.name: action_request_id
columns.label: Action request id
columns.description: The approved action request this executes; null for a direct call. At most one execution per request.

columns.name: connection_id
columns.label: Connection id
columns.description: The authorised sending connection, null for executions without a connection.

columns.name: operation
columns.label: Operation
columns.description: The enqueued operation (for example messages.send).

columns.name: arguments
columns.label: Arguments
columns.description: The operation's final arguments, as JSON, fixed when it was authorised.

columns.name: resolution
columns.label: Resolution
columns.description: What was resolved when it was authorised (a reply anchor, a connection), as JSON. Internal; not returned by the API.

columns.name: status
columns.label: Status
columns.description: queued (waiting or between attempts), claimed (an attempt is running), done or failed.

columns.name: client_ref
columns.label: Client ref
columns.description: The identifier the vault gave the outgoing item, the same on every attempt; internal.

columns.name: idempotency_key
columns.label: Idempotency key
columns.description: The key a direct caller chose: the same key and arguments answer the same execution. Unique per caller; null for an approved request.

columns.name: input_hash
columns.label: Input hash
columns.description: A SHA-256 of the operation and its canonical arguments, to recognise a repeated key; internal.

columns.name: deadline_at
columns.label: Deadline at
columns.description: When an execution that was never attempted stops being attempted (ten minutes after authorisation).

columns.name: dispatched_at
columns.label: Dispatched at
columns.description: When the last attempt reached the provider; internal.

columns.name: done_at
columns.label: Done at
columns.description: When it finished, done or failed.

columns.name: attempts
columns.label: Attempts
columns.description: How many attempts were started (at most five); internal.

columns.name: next_attempt_at
columns.label: Next attempt at
columns.description: When the next attempt is due; internal.

columns.name: lease_until
columns.label: Lease until
columns.description: When the running attempt's lease lapses; internal.

columns.name: lease_token
columns.label: Lease token
columns.description: Identifies the runner holding the lease; internal, never returned.

columns.name: last_error_code
columns.label: Last error code
columns.description: The class of the last attempt's failure, while it is retried; internal.

columns.name: result
columns.label: Result
columns.description: What the operation produced, as JSON; null until done.

columns.name: error_code
columns.label: Error code
columns.description: Why it failed: reauth_required, permission_missing, anchor_missing, provider_rejected, outcome_unknown, attempts_exhausted or deadline_passed.

columns.name: error_message
columns.label: Error message
columns.description: The vault's sentence for the failure; never a provider's own text.

tables.name: action_requests
tables.label: Action requests
tables.description: A proposed change awaiting review: a registered operation with its arguments, who proposed it and why. A person or agent with write on the target resource approves it (the operation then runs as the approver), rejects it, or the proposer withdraws it.

columns.name: id
columns.label: Id
columns.description: Unique id (UUIDv7).

columns.name: created_at
columns.label: Created at
columns.description: When the row was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.label: Updated at
columns.description: When the row last changed.

columns.name: organization_id
columns.label: Organization id
columns.description: The organisation that owns the row; always the deployment's single organisation.

columns.name: created_by
columns.label: Created by
columns.description: The principal (user or agent) that created the row.

columns.name: operation
columns.label: Operation
columns.description: The registered operation the request proposes (for example tasks.update).

columns.name: arguments
columns.label: Arguments
columns.description: The operation's flat arguments as proposed, as JSON. Never changed after creation.

columns.name: edited_arguments
columns.label: Edited arguments
columns.description: The complete replacement arguments a reviewer approved instead, as JSON; null unless approved with an edit.

columns.name: status
columns.label: Status
columns.description: pending, approved (an enqueued operation is queued, not yet run), rejected, withdrawn, expired, superseded, executed or failed.

columns.name: reason
columns.label: Reason
columns.description: Why the proposer asks for this change, plain text.

columns.name: evidence
columns.label: Evidence
columns.description: The messages and interactions the proposal rests on, as a JSON array of { type, id }.

columns.name: contact_id
columns.label: Contact id
columns.description: Context: the contact the request is about; not an input of the operation.

columns.name: thread_id
columns.label: Thread id
columns.description: Context: the thread the request is about; not an input of the operation.

columns.name: interaction_id
columns.label: Interaction id
columns.description: Context: the interaction the request is about; not an input of the operation.

columns.name: dedup_key
columns.label: Dedup key
columns.description: At most one pending request per key: the same proposer replaces its earlier one, another proposer is refused.

columns.name: expires_at
columns.label: Expires at
columns.description: When a pending request stops being approvable.

columns.name: decided_by
columns.label: Decided by
columns.description: The principal (user or agent) that approved, rejected or withdrew it, or the system when it expired.

columns.name: decided_at
columns.label: Decided at
columns.description: When the decision was made; null while pending.

columns.name: decision_reason
columns.label: Decision reason
columns.description: The reviewer's reason, when given.

columns.name: superseded_by_id
columns.label: Superseded by id
columns.description: The request that replaced this one, when it was superseded.

columns.name: result
columns.label: Result
columns.description: What approval did: the events an inline operation wrote, or the execution's result for a queued one, as JSON; null until executed.

columns.name: error_code
columns.label: Error code
columns.description: Why a queued execution failed (the same code as on the execution); null otherwise.

columns.name: error_message
columns.label: Error message
columns.description: The failure sentence of a queued execution; null otherwise.

columns.name: executed_at
columns.label: Executed at
columns.description: When the operation ran; null until then.

derived.name: execution_id
derived.label: Execution id
derived.description: The execution a queued approval created, from the execution's own link to the request; null until then and for operations that run inline. Derived, read-only.
